description: Angular component for a LED light visualization, using Raphael for SVG rendering and tinycolor for color manipulation.

classes.name: LedLightComponent
classes.description: Angular component that renders a LED light with customizable color, size, and glow effects.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes default properties and computes glow color.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Triggers initial rendering after view initialization.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updating the rendering accordingly.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Sets up the SVG canvas and draws the LED circle.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Updates the visual appearance of the LED based on its enabled state.
